bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token obtained from POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register. Include as: Authorization: Bearer {token}

errors.description: RFC 7807 validation error extensions — map of field name to list of error messages, e.g. { "email": ["Email is required"] }.

ProjectPriority.description: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Critical. Send as integer in request bodies.

ProjectStatus.description: 0=Planning, 1=Active, 2=OnHold, 3=Completed, 4=Archived. Send as integer in request bodies.

TaskItemStatus.description: 0=Todo, 1=InProgress, 2=Blocked, 3=Completed, 4=Cancelled. Send as integer in request bodies.

TaskPriority.description: 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Urgent. Send as integer in request bodies.
